Start your lessons in [[polymock]] by facing your first opponent.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Register three [[Polymock]] pieces for play with [[Denn]] [Polymock Unlocks] at [[Rata Sum]].
* Talk to Yulma [Polymock] to start the game.
* Defeat [[Yulma]] in a game of Polymock at Rata Sum.
* See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* [[Fire Imp Polymock piece]]

==Walkthrough==
Hoff will give you your three starter Polymock pieces: [[Gargoyle Polymock piece|Gargoyle]], [[Mergoyle Polymock piece|Mergoyle]], and [[Skale Polymock piece|Skale]]. With them in your [[inventory]], talk to [[Denn]] to register them one by one. A registered Polymock piece will be removed from your inventory and your character (and only that character) will be able to use this piece in any Polymock game. Once you have three pieces registered (if you don't have additional pieces from [[dungeon]] rewards), talk to [[Yulma]] to challenge her.

Yulma's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
#[[Gargoyle Polymock piece|Gargoyle]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Lightning Strike}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Lightning Orb}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Lightning Djinn's Haste}}
#[[Skale Polymock piece|Skale]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Deathly Chill}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Rising Bile}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Rotting Flesh}}
#[[Mergoyle Polymock piece|Mergoyle]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Overload}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Glyph Destabilization}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Mind Wreck}}

Yulma is fairly easy to beat. You can freely use any of the pieces you have against her in any order, although leaving the Gargoyle piece for last might be a good idea as it's your most damaging piece and you can use it to regain ground if you've lost your first two pieces.

Yulma can be a bit disconcerting to fight because she sometimes uses skills in odd combinations (such as using Glyph of Concentration and then Blocking, for example), and has frequent pauses in between using skills. This can make her somewhat difficult to predict (and therefore interrupt/block). In general, a good offense is the best way to deal with Yulma; it is possible to simply spam your offensive skills at her until she loses.
